name: FALCON-Bench
description:
FALCONEye: Finding Answers and Localizing Content in ONE-hour-long videos with multi-modal LLMs


    
        
    
    
        
    


    
        
        
    





This repo contains the benchmark presented in the paper "FALCONEye: Finding Answers and Localizing Content in ONE-hour-long videos with multi-modal LLMs".

	
		
		🔔 News:
	


🆕 12/2025: Code released!
🥳 11/2025: Paper accepted at WACV 2026!
⭐ 3/2025: We have released the FALCON-Bench and Paper! 🔥… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cplou99/FALCON-Bench.
general_score_metric: accuracy (for QA) and temporal_IOU / localization accuracy (for timestamp localization)
reputation: A newly released long-video multimodal benchmark on Hugging Face attracting interest from researchers working on long-context and video-capable multimodal LLMs.
